What's New

New Features

  • Added a fast mode toggle (bolt icon) next to the model picker in chat. Toggling fast mode on a Codex session sends a serviceTier: "fast" flag on the existing thread instead of starting a new session. Claude chat fast mode switches to a Haiku model. The toggle is only visible for backends that support it (Claude and Codex).
  • Added browser Direct/Compatibility mode picker in the browser pane header bar. Localhost pages now default to Compatibility Mode (proxy), but you can switch to Direct Mode to preserve the original localhost origin — useful for auth flows, CORS, and OAuth. The mode preference is remembered per project+host+port.
  • Added browser issue detection footer that automatically detects common localhost problems (HMR failures, CSP blocking, CORS errors, auth failures) and suggests switching browser mode with a one-click "Switch Mode" button.
  • Added Compatibility Mode remote API proxy so that localhost apps loaded through the Addy proxy can still reach remote APIs. The proxy rewrites Origin/Referer headers to the real localhost origin and handles cookie bridging, redirect rewriting, and CORS header stripping.
  • Codex chat now handles command execution approval requests — when Codex asks to run a shell command, Addy shows an Allow/Deny permission card instead of silently proceeding.
  • Added a Codex wrapper script that automatically applies --ask-for-approval never and --sandbox workspace-write defaults when Codex runs inside Addy's terminal environment.
  • Server and build panes now persist and restore across app restarts, including their command, process window shape, footer bar state, and owned-child workflow registration.
  • Server panes are now reused when an agent requests the same server command again — instead of creating a duplicate pane, the existing one is restarted.

Focus preservation

  • Agent-driven pane operations (split, open URL, browser JS evaluation, console open) no longer steal keyboard focus from the pane you're typing in. This includes cross-project scenarios where a background agent mutates panes in a hidden project.
  • Cmd+/Cmd-/Cmd+0 font scaling now works correctly in chat panes. Previously, focused text views could intercept the shortcuts before they reached the app. Chat messages, the empty state, and the composer all refresh at the new font size.
  • Terminal scrolling performance dramatically improved for panes with large scrollback buffers. Addy now handles scroll wheel events directly instead of routing through SwiftTerm's per-event overlay scroller animations.

Stdout line buffering optimized

  • the chat session line parser now slices into the incoming chunk directly instead of repeatedly copying into a growing buffer string.
  • Server pane "Start"/"Build" button now expands the footer shade and shows a spinning starting indicator while the process launches.
  • Server pane "Open" button now detects the server port from terminal output (e.g. "http://localhost:3001") rather than only parsing the launch command.
  • Browser pane now uses the default persistent WKWebView data store instead of a non-persistent one, fixing auth-heavy sites like Apple Developer that depend on normal cookie/session behavior.
  • Browser instrumentation, cache-busting, and CSP stripping scripts now only run on localhost pages, leaving real websites untouched.
  • Build panes now use a status marker to detect exit codes, making finite build completion more reliable than relying solely on process exit signals.
  • Background CLI processes (plan reviews, code reviews, inspector agents) now use the resolved absolute binary path from BackendRegistry instead of bare command names, and inherit the user's interactive shell environment — fixing "command not found" errors on machines where claude/codex aren't on the default PATH.
  • Codex config now sets defaulttoolsapproval_mode = "approve" on the Addy MCP server section, ensuring tool permissions flow through Addy's approval UI.
  • Chat card spacing and header padding refined for a cleaner look in both light and dark themes.

Worktree management improved

  • prunable worktrees are now tracked, duplicate sidebar entries are deduplicated, and stored worktree projects are reconciled against actual disk state on branch scan.
  • HTML responses from localhost dev servers are now rewritten to keep asset and WebSocket URLs pointing at the proxy origin, preventing broken resources when loading through Compatibility Mode.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed focus stealing when input request views in hidden/inactive project panes attempted to auto-focus their text fields.
  • Fixed a crash when spawning code review sub-agents caused by Auto Layout constraints being activated on views not yet in the view hierarchy (ReviewAgentStatusView).
  • Fixed cross-project MCP tool routing where an implicit sourcepaneid from the calling pane overrode an explicit project_path, causing browser and server panes to open in the wrong project.
  • Fixed attachment preview cards showing a large blank gap above file/image thumbnails by applying proper stack alignment and explicit height constraints.
  • Fixed Codex app-server initialization hanging indefinitely — a 5-second timeout now falls back to legacy transport if the app-server doesn't respond.
  • Fixed user stop during app-server initialization leaving the session in a broken state.
  • Fixed the Direct Mode content rule list failing to compile due to an unsupported URL filter disjunction — split into separate rules for localhost, 127.0.0.1, and [::1].
  • Fixed the owned child pane rail visual artifact being left behind after the rail was removed.
  • Fixed cloud-synced projects without a local path incorrectly showing the "New Branch" context menu action.
  • Fixed sidebar worktree creation not showing an error alert when git worktree add fails.

What's New

IMPORTANT

  • New pane shortcuts are now cmd+T instead of cmd+D

New Features

  • Added a dedicated Build tool (addyrunbuild) that agents can use to run compile and build commands in their own managed pane, keeping your terminal free.
  • Agents now receive a structured runtime identity block in their prompts, giving them reliable awareness of which pane they're in, what project they're working on, and whether they're a sub-agent.
  • Added ⇧⌘C keyboard shortcut to open the Conversations pane. Tests pane moved to ⇧⌘D.

Improvements

  • Chat is now backed by a virtualized NSTableView instead of a plain stack view. Conversations with hundreds of messages scroll, resize, and stream dramatically faster without UI stalls.
  • Multiple performance passes eliminated main-thread stalls during chat resize, conversation preview loading, theme palette switching, and tool group rendering. Added a native frame-pointer backtrace sampler to pinpoint bottlenecks.
  • Owned child panes (sub-agents, reviews, tests, servers, builds) now share a unified vertical stack attached to their parent pane. Mixed stacks of different pane types render correctly, and closing a child pane properly cleans up the hierarchy.
  • The "Collapse reviews by default" setting now applies to all sub-processes — reviews, tests, and sub-agents — and has been renamed accordingly.
  • Theme picker in Settings now uses a sidebar layout with Light/Dark/System options on the left and a larger preview on the right.
  • Settings headings moved into the header bar for a cleaner look with tighter spacing.
  • Built-in model profiles now show concrete names like "Claude Opus 4.7 (Latest)" instead of generic "Latest" labels. Legacy saved profiles are migrated automatically.
  • Pasted images are now automatically downscaled to fit API dimension limits before sending, preventing agent crashes from oversized screenshots.
  • Conversations pane pagination no longer gets stuck when multiple chats are streaming simultaneously.
  • Codex chat now handles MCP elicitation requests, enabling tool permission prompts during Codex sessions.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed chat messages being cropped or clipped at the bottom of the scroll view after restore or resize.
  • Fixed streaming text duplicating the first word or prefix during live Codex chat output.
  • Fixed thinking blocks not rendering correctly — restored the thought bubble accessory, fixed collapsed card height, and ensured expand/collapse animations work properly.
  • Fixed chat not pinning to the bottom when you send a message while the assistant is streaming.
  • Fixed streaming row heights not updating as content grows, causing text to overlap or get hidden.
  • Fixed a reentrant NSTableView crash that could occur when messages streamed in during a layout pass.
  • Fixed the Plans pane "Mark Complete" button not working — it was incorrectly requiring auto-review prerequisites.
  • Fixed git pane failing to stage files with spaces or special characters in their paths (quoted porcelain path decoding).
  • Bounded git provider process execution to prevent runaway subprocesses from hanging the git pane.
  • Fixed tool group card animations firing on the wrong cell when scrolling quickly during expand/collapse.
  • Resolved Auto Layout conflicts in the pane header bar, memory view, and expandable cards.
  • Fixed permission card deduplication in chat tool rollups so repeated permission prompts don't pile up.
  • Fixed blank chat view that could appear after switching conversations.

What's New

New Features

  • Added a Populate button to the Why card that appears on hover, kicking off a guided interview to fill in your project philosophy.
  • Code review submissions now support chunked/progressive review for large diffs, letting you review big PRs in manageable passes.

Improvements

  • Chat now uses a virtualized list, so conversations with hundreds of messages scroll, resize, and stream updates dramatically faster without UI stalls.
  • Context window sizes updated for the latest models: Claude Opus 4.7/4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 now use a 1M window, GPT-5 Codex variants use 400K, and Gemini 3 Pro/Flash are recognized. Addy also prefers its own known limits when a CLI reports a stale smaller value, so the gauge reflects the model's real capacity.
  • The review pane got a visual refresh: cancel button, pill-style severity badges, meta cards with commit and file info, and a cleaner dropdown for switching between reviews.

Attachment carousel polish

  • more prominent navigation arrows, a full-width bottom border, and gradients that now sit flush to the edges.
  • The conversation sidebar preview and chat resizing no longer stutter on the main thread, making window resizing and session switching feel noticeably snappier.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a reentrant crash in the chat list that could occur while messages streamed in during a layout pass.
  • Resolved Auto Layout conflicts that could log warnings or cause jitter in the pane header bar, memory view, and expandable cards on hover.
  • Fixed several chat display issues including scroll anchoring, diff rendering, and text-content link handling regressions.

Internal Changes

  • Added a native frame-pointer backtrace sampler (AddyBacktrace) used to pinpoint main-thread stalls, enabling the performance work above.

What's New

  • Prepares for first Alpha release

What's New

  • Adds logging and events
